reviews.title: Disappointing Experience Despite Having a Paid Subscription
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with Willow TV. I have an active paid subscription, but today, when Bangladesh is playing a Test match against the West Indies, I couldn’t find the match anywhere on the platform. I refreshed the app several times, but the match never appeared.

What is the point of paying for a cricket streaming service if I cannot watch the matches I want to see? As a cricket fan, I expect reliable coverage and clear information about which matches are available.

This experience has been frustrating and disappointing. Willow should improve its service and clearly communicate broadcasting availability to paying subscribers. Until then, I cannot recommend this service.

reviews.title: Not ideal
reviews.text:
New version of the app is not ideal. It’s clunky. Hard to find the replays, and you can’t hide scores. As a fan of India, a lot of their matches are played before I wake up and I don’t want to know the score before I watch the match back. Also, most apps have the ability to start a match from the beginning even if the match is currently live. Willow has never been able to figure that out and I wish they would.

Update 10/25: interface is still terrible, hide scores has been added back, but how are we still not able to start a live match from the beginning if we miss part of it. That needs to be added in to make the experience better. And find a way to stop randomly signing you out. That would be great too. I’ll stay with Willow on Prime Video or Triller TV. Much better experience that way

reviews.title: So much potential but lacks common sense
reviews.text:
The Willow app offers plenty of cricket content, which is its biggest strength. Unfortunately, the user experience leaves a lot to be desired.

The interface feels unorganized, and finding matches by league or tournament is much harder than it should be. My biggest frustration is that the app constantly displays the final scores everywhere. If I’m trying to watch a replay of a match, the result is spoiled before I even get to press play. That completely defeats the purpose of offering replays.

The app has a solid content library, but it desperately needs a major user interface overhaul. Better organization, improved navigation, and an option to hide scores for replay viewers would make a huge difference. These issues have existed for a long time, and it feels like user feedback hasn’t been acted upon.

reviews.title: $10 a month for this app is a joke
reviews.text:
I use Willow cricket for one single thing-watching cricket matches while I live in the US. Well that one thing they’re able to provide. Everything else-a huge mess. 

For $10 a month-the same price by the way that Netflix charges-you expect at minimum of functioning app. Netflix is seamless, polished. willow on the other hand feels like it’s still in its beta phase. They are still working on it. This is in the final product.

Videos randomly stop playing and throw the “try again later”. Except the video that is already recorded and on your app not playing? When they do play basic options like forwarding and reminding a video is a joke. You rewind for 10 seconds and suddenly the video has restarted from the very beginning why? No one knows. The interface itself is chaotic. it is very cluttered and not at all organized. 

So I always find it hilarious that they charge the same price as Netflix meanwhile, the experience couldn’t be more laughable. If Willow is going to charge $10 a month, the minimum they can do is provide a functional app where videos play whenever you want them to and basic things like forwarding and reminding a video does not completely mess up your experience.

reviews.title: A Complete Scam - Takes your money, pushes ads, TV app is broken!
reviews.text:
If I could give zero stars, I would. I bought a Willow by Cricbuzz subscription specifically to watch the T20 World Cup on my TV, but the TV app is completely broken. Every time I try to activate it, I get a generic 'Something went wrong. Please try again later.' The OTP email login is also broken—the emails never arrive!
I am NOT using a VPN, just a standard direct connection. Thinking there was a glitch on my end, I created a brand-new, clean account and actually paid for a SECOND parallel subscription in the same month just to get it to work. It still failed. The app happily takes your money twice, but completely blocks TV access once you've paid.
A quick internet search shows countless other customers have been facing this exact same TV login issue .Yet, the developers completely ignore it. Instead of fixing their broken app, they just concentrate on capturing as many subscriptions as possible and selling their advertisements to US entities without providing the actual service you paid for.
I didn't even bother emailing their support because a T20 match is only 3 hours long—who has time to sit around waiting for a slow email response while the live game is over? I was forced to watch on a tiny phone screen instead of the TV I paid for. This service is an absolute cash grab. Save your money and find an alternative!"

reviews.title: Spoilers
reviews.text:
They used to have a setting to turn off scores in the Home Screen of the app. Seeing as this is largely a service targeting an American audience, that makes sense; time zone differences make watching matches live difficult I. The US. 

They have seemingly removed that setting, and there doesn’t seem to currently be a way to access Willow content without seeing the score of the match right in front of you. I’ve had every World Cup match ruined since, god forbid, I don’t get up at 3AM to watch a match live. What am I even paying for at this point?

reviews.title: Trash app
reviews.text:
Subscribed unfortunately to their annual plan. No Live match, which you pay for, ever plays! All you see is a wheel spinning! The recorded/ old games play fine, but that’s not what you pay them for! They won’t respond to your complaints for days on end , email being the only option offered for doing so! If you hope to watch the live games on your tv,air playing it from your cell phone might work but forget about using your cell phone for the duration then! 
Two thumbs down for this scammy, glitchy app!

reviews.title: Just when you think it couldn’t get worse!
reviews.text:
Willow has just updated its tv app, which has to be the worst update ever in history of updates!
Rather than improving an already buggy app, they have made it a worse and totally miserable experience. Finding games on an overcrowded screen, with busy loud colours requires standing up and getting within inches. Games cannot restart where you left off! These are 5 day, 8 hours a day games, ffs!
Replay games that show a million highlights but not the entire game! What were they smoking!!

reviews.title: Paid subscriber - Blocked on Samsung TV - App not syncing
reviews.text:
The Willow TV by Cricbuzz app on Samsung TV has serious functionality issues that need immediate attention.
The TV app only shows a password login option and does not provide the code-based login available on the mobile app. Even after logging in with my password, my profile and active monthly subscription do not sync. The TV app incorrectly prompts me to “Subscribe to Willow” despite having an active subscription.
Currently, the only way I can watch matches on my TV is by casting from the mobile app. However, casting is unstable and the stream pauses unexpectedly, switches to ads randomly during live matches, and frequently disconnects. All other apps and casting services work flawlessly on the same TV and Wi-Fi network, so this is clearly not a connectivity issue.
This reflects poorly on the Samsung TV version of the app. It is unstable, poorly synchronized, and clearly not optimized. As a paying subscriber, this is very disappointing. Hope they investigate and fix these issues promptly.

reviews.title: Bait and Switch
reviews.text: These guys are masters of the bait and switch game. Their subscription volumes tend to swell when there are large tournaments and wane immediately after. So they find ways to offer you the option of watching a game free on the App to entice customers in. They make it easy to sign up initially as in my case of being able to subscribe from my Apple TV account. As soon as I had subscribed, I was able to watch the game without any hitches. After a couple of days I realized I could no longer use the Apple TV  to view games as my subscription was not recognized. I still managed to open my App and AirPlay to my Apple TV. It was a hurdle. It still meant I could view games. On day 3 that option was also revoked. They do not recognize the active subscription on my phone or Apple TV now. This has happened in the past also where I have signed up for a direct account with them and these guys effectively managed to charge me twice. I wish they simply priced the product higher if revenues were the problem. This bait and switch strategy leaves a bad taste in the mouth and deters brand loyalty. There is nothing more annoying than cow towing to people that strategically use their only provider status unethically. This is why this App and service is rated so poorly.

reviews.title: Scores and Spoilers Displayed Throughout the App
reviews.text:
For those of us watching the full match replay from the U.S., the app is frustrating to use because there are spoilers everywhere. There’s no way to watch the full replay without already knowing the result, which takes the excitement out of the game. While there is a “hide scores” option on the website, there are still enough spoilers before you even navigate to the replay section to ruin the experience.

Additionally, watching through web browsers constantly lags and freezes, making it nearly unwatchable. I’ve reported this issue multiple times, but there has been no fix.

I have an annual subscription, so I don’t receive a refund if I cancel now. However, if this continues to be the experience, I do not plan to renew once my subscription expires.

reviews.title: Update broke everything
reviews.text:
Login - doesn’t work if you were using login via apple account

TV Streaming- doesn’t work on apple TV, it seems they updated the settings to subscription per device rather than building a mechanism to prevent password sharing

Customer service - non existent, since last October all reviews are 1 star, yet developer isn’t paying attention, product team is non-existent too

In app streaming - starting today it broke too, saying you have ad blocker enabled (where I didn’t have any ad blocker) why would a paid subscription streaming be blocked for ad blocker?

Overall, it appears to be a project done by a vibe coder from an AI based coding platform, nothing works. They decide to revamp an app (that was working) in middle of a world cup.

Canceling the subscription was another pain, on clicking cancel subscription it wasn’t doing anything. Had to attempt atleast 15 (no exaggeration) times to unsubscribe.

reviews.title: New Apple TV version is ugly
reviews.text:
I have been a long‑time Willow TV subscriber, and the new application version integrated with Cricbuzz has significantly diminished the overall user experience. The app now requires me to log in with my phone every time I launch it on Apple TV, which is extremely inconvenient. Key features such as the match schedule are missing, and displaying score summaries next to replays removes the excitement of watching matches without knowing the result in advance.

Additionally, I frequently encounter “Some error occurred” messages, which makes the app unreliable. At this point, I genuinely wish there were a viable alternative to Willow TV for watching cricket.

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text:
The Willow Cricket app is extremely frustrating to use. Streams constantly buffer, freeze, or crash—especially during important matches. Even with a paid subscription, you’re forced to sit through ads, which makes no sense at all.
The app interface feels outdated and clunky, navigation is confusing, and casting to TV or Chromecast barely works. Half the time the app forgets where you stopped watching, so you have to restart from the beginning.
Customer support is almost nonexistent, and subscription management is a headache. For something that charges a premium price, the performance is unacceptable. This app seriously needs major improvements in stability, user experience, and reliability.
Would not recommend unless you have absolutely no other option to watch cricket.

reviews.title: Broken!
reviews.text:
The Willow tv app used to be decent. I was using it for last couple of years. But recently after Cricbuzz branding, it went completely broken. Initially app was working but not the website on laptop. Now the app no longer works. It kept asking for login and even after login with their new OTP based login. Also they ask for selection of cookies but nothing works if you select your cookie choice!
Shows incompetency of their developers when they pushed on a product without proper testing. I am looking for other options to watch cricket.

reviews.title: Willow hate their subscribers and are either sadists, stupid or insane
reviews.text: Willow just updated their Apple TV app and it is essentially non-functional for the simple thing we pay them for, which is to be able to open the app, find either live cricket matches or replays and watch them. For some bizarre reason, they completely took away the simple navigation where you could see upcoming matches or find recent matches by date or by series, and buried any simple clear functionality in a garbage ocean of highlights and other nonsense. To make matters worse, if you are able to find the replay you want, they bizarrely decided to list the results below the replay button and there is no way to turn this off (despite every sports app in existence offering this option.) People used to joke that Willow hated their viewers because their app was a bit amateurish compared to others, but at least it was navigable and functional. This new version appears to be designed by morons that don’t even know what sports are, much less watch them. Unless they fix this, there is no reason to subscribe to this app, it is essentially non-functional.

reviews.title: Latest update is horrible
reviews.text: I have no idea who thought the latest update was an improvement, but they should be sacked. The previous version was not ideal but it wasn’t a blizzard of color like the new one. One particularly stupid change is within the archives, where the full replay is no longer edited for ease of viewing. For example, I am watching the WPL - each T20 match used to have a separate video for each innings. Now I get to sit through 20-30 minutes of “Please wait a minute . . .”  before play actually starts and then the whole coverage as one 4+ hour video. How is this an improvement?

reviews.title: Worst support/Technical team
reviews.text:
Please replace your entire technical team. Do you guys even have QA in your team. I don't think there is even a single test before deployment. Willow was best before Cricbuzz acquired them. 
Problem 1- My crickbuzz account is never sync with active subscription. Raised 10+ tickets, no response. 
Problem 2- I cannot now login on laptop, always erroring out. 
Problem 3- Even though I am logged in on willow app, if I want to raise a ticket, I cannot because it asks me to login again which never happens. 
It is better to buy a vpn and start watching.

reviews.title: If only there was another choice
reviews.text:
Worst app ever.  If India is playing, don’t even bother trying to watch.  Its spends more time frozen than playing.  Plays ok well outside of big game time.   Really clunky app.  Hard to get to game replays without seeing highlights so you pretty much know how the game went.  That’s assuming you toggle the show scores off.  Cannot easily scroll to a certain spot, just 3-4 minutes at a time.  

Unfortunately if you want to watch certain games in the USA this is the only option.  I love watching cricket but not on Willow.

reviews.title: Case study for how monopolies destroy innovation
reviews.text:
it weren’t for the year displayed on my phone, I’d genuinely believe we’re still living in 2003 — because that’s clearly where Willow HQ got stuck while the rest of the world moved on to high-quality streaming and modern interfaces. Meanwhile, we’re paying premium prices for potato-resolution streams, random buffering marathons, and enough latency to hear the final wicket fall from our neighbors before Willow shows us the bowler’s run-up.

And the ads — oh, the ads. Nothing says “we value our customers” like being force-fed the same Valero and Toyota commercials every time I dare to blink. A 5-second break? Cool, get ready for 30 seconds of déjà-vu advertising hell. It’s like the app is punishing us for trying to enjoy cricket.

The funniest (or saddest?) part: this is the official broadcaster for major cricket tournaments. The pinnacle of the sport — delivered like a college project gone wrong. ICC doesn’t care. BCCI doesn’t care. Willow certainly doesn’t care. Monopoly is a lovely business model when you’ve mastered “bare minimum,” I guess.

To any Willow representative doom-scrolling through complaints: perhaps try focusing on streaming the actual match properly before dreaming up new ways to show us the same car ad for the 400th time?

Anyway, keep ignoring this feedback. The world will eventually find better ways to keep up with cricket. Your monopoly won’t protect you forever. Until then, thanks for the nostalgia — I never asked to return to the early 2000s, but here we

reviews.title: Gone awry
reviews.text:
There was a time when Disney were looking to acquire WillowTV for their streaming tech before eventually going in deep with BAMTech. Oh how the mighty have fallen. 

While it still remains the only legitimate way to watch most Cricket in the US(ESPN's diminishing interest not withstanding) their ad infusion has gotten way overboard, down to Sony Max levels in the 2010s. 

The sport is built for ads and yet still there is a tasteful way to approach it. All of which, they knew how to do right at an earlier time, when maybe the rights weren't as expensive, while the market wasn't that big. 

Now with the effective monopoly, it is full of misplaced ads from an extremely small catalog of Money Transfer and Frozen Grocery products, with the odd Fortune Teller thrown in. The good old days of Toyota ads are gone. 

FAST services like Viki and IQIYI have launched after Willow but have a robust offering without a buggy ad experience while Willow is  subjecting their paid premium subscribers to such droll. 

But it is a choice they're making to ignore the regressed viewing experience for as long as they have. A choice backed by the monopoly of the viewing rights.

reviews.title: Best ridiculous app ever
reviews.text:
Congratulations to this app for redefining what a premium subscription means: paying money to watch ads… occasionally interrupted by cricket. The stream freezes every 30 seconds like clockwork, just long enough to reload and—surprise!—show me the same ad again. Truly innovative.
The glitches are relentless, but hey, at least the ads work perfectly. 

Clearly all the engineering effort went into monetization, not something trivial like “streaming video.” User experience? Never heard of it.
And let’s talk about ad variety—or rather, the lack of it. Seeing the exact same ridiculous ad all day long really adds to the psychological endurance test. 

It’s less a streaming service and more an experiment in how much nonsense a paying customer will tolerate.
Cricket fans in the U.S. deserve better than this clown show. Hopefully, a competent competitor eventually steps in to stream worldwide matches—one that understands the radical concept that premium should mean fewer ads, not more.
